diffusive_limit.two_thirds_rule_as_coded: the state is truncated to |kx|,|ky| <= floor(n/3) = 21: the mask multiplies the whole tendency (nonlinear + diffusion) and run() zeroes the initial state outside it

bracketing_series_every_0.1.provenance: same crate and commands as bracketing_cmds with --every 0.1 instead of 0.5 (frames every 3 steps), rerun 2026-09-19 for the blow-up figure (week4/figures/verification.typ, blowup-canvas); stdout t E Z at full precision. dt 0.033 stops non-finite at t = 7.92 as in the every-0.5 run; the last finite energy, 4.9e240 at t = 7.821, is off any chart.

diffusive_limit.provenance: fixtures/week4-reference-rust (Rust answer key, state truncated to the 2/3 set), commands relative to that crate with target/release on PATH; stdout t E Z at full precision, fields.jsonl at 6 decimals; scan: field taylor-green --n 64 | fluid --method <m> --nu 0.1 --dt <dt> --t-end 8 --every 0.5 --out <dir>, dt in steps of 0.001

before_state_truncation.note: crate BEFORE state truncation: diffusion acts on all n^2 modes, |k|^2_max = 2*(n/2)^2 = 2048; measured with the crate as it stood before this change (diffusion on all n^2 modes)

advective_limit.prediction: dt = 2.8284 / (U_max |k|_max), RK4 imaginary-axis limit, frozen coefficients
advective_limit.provenance: fixtures/week4-reference-rust (Rust answer key, state truncated to the 2/3 set), commands relative to that crate with target/release on PATH; stdout t E Z at full precision, fields.jsonl at 6 decimals; scan: field random --n 128 --seed 2026 --k-min 2 --k-max 6 | fluid --method rk4 --nu 0.004 --dt <dt> --t-end 10 --every 0.5, dt = 0.010, 0.012, ..., 0.040

bracketing_series_every_0.1.provenance: same crate and commands as the scan with --every 0.1 instead of 0.5 (frames every 3 steps at dt 0.040, every 3 steps at 0.038), rerun 2026-09-19 for the blow-up figure; stdout t E Z at full precision. The non-finite check runs at snapshot times, so with --every 0.1 the dt 0.040 run reports the non-finite energy at t = 1.08 (step 27), one step after the every-0.5 run's 1.04 (step 26); the committed stop time stays 1.04.

euler_contract_step_series.provenance: fixtures/week4-reference-rust (Rust answer key), run 2026-09-20 for the blow-up figure; stdout t E Z at full precision. Forward Euler at the contract step dt = 0.01: E = 0.4574 at t = 1.0, E = 2.6e43 at t = 1.3, non-finite at t = 1.4 (step 140; with --every 0.5 the check reports 1.5). No imaginary stability interval: the advective modes at |z| up to 1.44i grow from the first step.

energy_budget_by_method.note: checker line 6: |E(T)-E(0) + 2 nu int Z dt| / |E(T)-E(0)|, trapezoid over frames every 0.1; tolerance 1e-3. RK2 at dt 0.01 passes with 11x margin: the budget cannot tell a second-order stepper from RK4; Euler at dt 0.001 fails.

field_error_at_largest_stable_rk4_step.note: field taylor-green --n 64 | fluid --method rk4 --nu 0.1 --dt <dt> --t-end 1 --every 0.1; err_6dec is the checker's taylor-green-field formula on the last stored frame (t = last multiple of 3 steps); all sit at the 7e-7 storage floor, energy error ~5e-12

perturbation_divergence.measure: relative distance ||omega_1 - omega_2|| / ||omega_1|| between the unperturbed run (1) and the perturbed run (2), per stored frame of fields.jsonl (6-decimal omega)
perturbation_divergence.perturbation: python3 perturb_mode.py 1e-5 (adds 1e-5 * max(|u|,|v|) * cos(3x) sin(4y) to u and subtracts 1e-5 * max(|u|,|v|) * sin(3x) cos(4y) from v of the field JSON, x = 2 pi ix / n, y = 2 pi iy / n)

cmds: field random --n 128 --seed 2026 --k-min 2 --k-max 6 | python3 perturb_mode.py 1e-5 | fluid --method rk4 --nu 0.004 --dt 0.01 --t-end 20 --every 0.5 --out rnd1
field taylor-green --n 64 | python3 perturb_mode.py 1e-5 | fluid --method rk4 --nu 0.1 --dt 0.01 --t-end 20 --every 0.5 --out tg1
taylor_green.note: below t = 2 the distance sits at the 6-decimal rounding floor of the frames; frames whose two rounded fields coincide read exactly 0 and the figure skips them. The relative floor rises late because omega itself decays as e^(-0.2 t).
